correctness.rationale: Every shuffle root has exactly one one, u_k=0^k1 0^(m-1-k). Necessity and sufficiency of two-copy allocation give L=max(ceil(a/2),a+b-m+1), U=min(a,floor((a+b)/2),m-1) for w=0^a1 0^b1 0^c. Requiring at least r roots subtracts 2(r-1) from each gap and bijects to a single-root word at m-3(r-1), giving H(h)=1+3 binom(h,2). Limit tail P(R/m>t)=3/4(1-3t)^2 on (0,1/3), hence mass 1/4 at zero and density 9/2(1-3t). Independent interleaving-dynamic-program checks agree on small all-word cases.
